description: Jaguar Code is a team of two developers from Cochabamba, Bolivia. Jose Luis Larrazabal (CTO) leads the architecture, reviews every change and deploys the web app and the APK. Pedro Rolon Fenalti works on the NASA data, the validation against the SMAP satellite and the pitch. We built CHAKRA with AI coding assistants, and every change passes tests and human review before it is merged.
